mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and supports asset prices, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through accommodative monetary policy expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% signal weak labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and labor force participation (PAYEMS growth) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS exceed 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), accommodative policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic recovery gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 850,000 units reflect strong consumer demand and economic confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 850,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Annual inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) erodes purchasing power and increases central bank tightening risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals stagflation risk, triggering market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates supply chain disruptions and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
